Sealed event hierarchy and the asynchronous publish-subscribe event bus.

1.0.0

    Description
    BlockchainEvent
    Sealed base type for all events published on the BlockchainEventBus.
    BlockchainEvent.BlockAddedEvent
    Fired after a new block is successfully appended to the canonical chain.
    BlockchainEvent.ForkDetectedEvent
    Fired when the node detects two competing valid blocks at the same chain height.
    BlockchainEvent.PeerConnectedEvent
    Fired when a new peer successfully establishes a TCP connection to this node.
    BlockchainEvent.PeerDisconnectedEvent
    Fired when a peer connection is closed, either gracefully or due to an error.
    BlockchainEvent.TransactionSubmittedEvent
    Fired after a transaction successfully passes validation and enters the mempool.
    BlockchainEventBus
    Thread-safe, asynchronous publish/subscribe event bus for blockchain lifecycle events.
    BlockchainEventListener
    Listener interface for receiving events from the BlockchainEventBus.
